name: Akikawa Suika
source:
"Hello, Sensei. Are you heading to class now?"

A saint who believes that helping the weak is her duty. There is nothing wrong with that.
However, whether the other party wants her help or not is irrelevant to her.
Even if you try to run away, she will come after you and there is no way you can refuse her.
In fact, if you refuse her too strongly, she will try to protect you by force ......in other words, she will kidnap you. 
No, that's not all there is to it.
She will surely be force you to train like hell.
Why is she so inflexible?
It's reality that she is the problem.
To the ignorant [url=/c113636]sensei[/url], she very scary.
Well, her face is cute and her outfit is sexy, so she is not that scary.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 158 cm
Occupation: Holy Woman
